rules.name: MRP (Maximum Retail Price)
rules.error_msg: MRP must be present in format 'Rs. X/-' or '₹X'.

rules.name: MRP Inclusive of All Taxes (Semantic Check)
rules.prompt: Look at the text and determine if it explicitly states or implies that the price is inclusive of all taxes. Be tolerant of typos like 'inv. of all taxes', 'inc. taxes', or '(incl.)'. If the concept of tax inclusion is present, respond PASS. If it is completely missing, respond FAIL.
rules.error_msg: Tax inclusion statement not found semantically.

rules.name: Net Quantity
rules.error_msg: Net quantity with standard unit (g, kg, ml, L) not found.

rules.name: Manufacturer/Importer Details
rules.error_msg: Manufacturer or importer name and address not found.

rules.name: Consumer Care Details
rules.error_msg: Consumer care phone number or email not found.

rules.name: MRP Numeral Height
rules.error_msg: Numerals must be at least 2mm high for standard packaging.

rules.name: Commodity Name in Hindi and English
rules.error_msg: Product must carry declarations in Hindi and English (or local language).

rules.name: Country of Origin Declaration

rules.name: Manufacturing/Packing Date

rules.name: Unit Sale Price

rules.name: Batch/Lot Number
rules.error_msg: Batch or Lot number not found.

rules.name: Complete Address
rules.error_msg: Manufacturer/Packer address with PIN code not found.

rules.name: Misleading Marketing Claims
rules.prompt: Analyze the text for contradictory or misleading marketing claims. For example, if it claims to be '100% Fresh' or '100% Natural' but lists 'Artificial Flavors', 'Preservatives', or 'Reconstituted' elsewhere. If there are NO misleading contradictions, respond PASS. If you detect a clear misleading contradiction, respond FAIL.
rules.error_msg: Misleading or contradictory claims detected on packaging.
